responsibility: Documents the configuration-generated files in the @file{gcc} build directory and what each one is for. It explains how @command{configure}, @file{config.gcc}, @file{mkconfig.sh}, host/target fragments, and language fragments produce files such as @file{Makefile}, @file{auto-host.h}, @file{config.h}, @file{tconfig.h}, and @file{tm_p.h}, clarifying which headers and build artifacts are intended for host, build, or target programs.
